summary: Dispatches on an action ID derived from this[205] minus 236. When the value is at most 0xB1, a jump table (byte_46713C) selects the case: case 0 and case 1 invoke a virtual method at vtable+28 on the dword_7CD8C0 dispatch interface with argument 14 or 11 respectively, and when the call returns nonzero ObjectNameComparison runs on this; case 2 returns 0 immediately. All other paths return 0.

local_names.v3: result of the virtual dispatch call

operations.description: v2 = this[205] - 236: compute the action index from the field at this+0x334.
if ( v2 <= 0xB1 ) enter the switch dispatch; larger values fall through to return 0.
Switch on byte_46713C[v2] using jump table base jpt_4670FC to select case 0, 1, or 2.
Case 0: invoke the virtual method at vtable+28 on dword_7CD8C0 with argument 14.
Case 1: invoke the virtual method at vtable+28 on dword_7CD8C0 with argument 11.
if ( v3 ) (the shared path after cases 0 and 1) call ObjectNameComparison(this).
Call ObjectNameComparison(this) when the dispatch returned nonzero.
Case 2 and the fall-through path both return 0.

unresolved: Meaning of the argument codes 14 and 11 passed to the dword_7CD8C0 virtual method is unknown.
Identity of the vtable+28 method on dword_7CD8C0 and what ObjectNameComparison validates is unknown.
jpt_4670FC (0x00467130) is referenced only as the jump-table base for byte_46713C indexing; its full contents are not evidenced here.
